sources.title: Krea 2: AI Image Foundation Model & Style Control
sources.snippet: Create expressive AI images with Krea 2, Krea AI's in-house foundation model for aesthetic diversity, style control, moodboards, and creative workflows.

sources.title: Krea 2 - Krea
sources.snippet: Krea 2 is our first foundation image model, built from scratch for full creative control over style, composition, aesthetics, and reference-driven results.

sources.title: Krea 2 AI Image Generator | Image Model Built for Aesthetics
sources.snippet: Krea 2 is an image model built for aesthetics, turning prompts, references, and moodboards into polished AI images with clear composition and flexible style control.

sources.title: Krea 2 - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Krea 2 is Krea AI's real-time generative image model for highly controllable visual creation and editing. It is designed for instant iterative workflows, allowing users to guide style, composition, structure, and visual identity interactively rather than relying on one-shot prompt generation.

sources.title: Krea 2 - SeaArt AI Model
sources.snippet: Explore Krea 2 model on SeaArt AI. Transform your idea into professional-quality AI-generated images and videos with our free, easy-to-use platform.
